rows.q: 各产品类别的销售额是多少
rows.sql: SELECT p."产品类别", ROUND(SUM(o."金额"), 2) AS "销售额" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" GROUP BY p."产品类别" ORDER BY "销售额" DESC LIMIT 100

rows.q: 各城市的订单数是多少
rows.sql: SELECT c."城市", COUNT(o."订单ID") AS "订单数" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."客户ID" = c."客户ID" GROUP BY c."城市" ORDER BY "订单数" DESC LIMIT 100

rows.q: 各客户等级的消费金额是多少
rows.sql: SELECT c."等级", ROUND(SUM(o."金额"), 2) AS "消费金额" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."客户ID" = c."客户ID" GROUP BY c."等级" ORDER BY "消费金额" DESC LIMIT 100

rows.q: 销售额最高的产品类别是哪个
rows.sql: SELECT p."产品类别", ROUND(SUM(o."金额"), 2) AS "销售额" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" GROUP BY p."产品类别" ORDER BY "销售额" DESC LIMIT 1
rows.detail: 期望包含「手机配件」实得['手机配件', '54467505.0']

rows.q: 订单数最少的城市是哪个
rows.sql: SELECT c."城市", COUNT(o."订单ID") AS "订单数" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."客户ID" = c."客户ID" GROUP BY c."城市" ORDER BY "订单数" ASC LIMIT 1
rows.detail: 期望包含「苏州」实得['苏州', '3781']

rows.q: 黄金客户的消费金额是多少
rows.sql: SELECT c."等级", ROUND(SUM(o."金额"), 2) AS "消费金额" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."客户ID" = c."客户ID" WHERE c."等级" = '黄金' GROUP BY c."等级"

rows.q: 上海客户的订单数是多少
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "订单数" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."客户ID" = c."客户ID" WHERE c."城市" = '上海'

rows.q: 音频设备类别的销量是多少
rows.sql: SELECT SUM(o."数量") AS "音频设备销量" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" WHERE p."产品类别" = '音频设备'

rows.q: 各供应商的销售额是多少
rows.sql: SELECT s."供应商名称", ROUND(SUM(o."金额"), 2) AS "销售额" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" JOIN suppliers s ON p."供应商ID" = s."供应商ID" GROUP BY s."供应商名称" ORDER BY "销售额" DESC LIMIT 100

rows.q: 各供应商的订单数是多少
rows.sql: SELECT s."供应商名称", COUNT(o."订单ID") AS "订单数" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" JOIN suppliers s ON p."供应商ID" = s."供应商ID" GROUP BY s."供应商名称" ORDER BY "订单数" DESC LIMIT 100

rows.q: 销售额最高的供应商是哪个
rows.sql: SELECT s."供应商名称", ROUND(SUM(o."金额"), 2) AS "销售额" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" JOIN suppliers s ON p."供应商ID" = s."供应商ID" GROUP BY s."供应商名称" ORDER BY "销售额" DESC LIMIT 1
rows.detail: 期望包含「华北科技」实得['华北科技', '60223260.0']

rows.q: 华东地区供应商的销售额是多少
rows.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o."金额"), 2) AS "销售额" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" JOIN suppliers s ON p."供应商ID" = s."供应商ID" WHERE s."所在地区" = '华东'

rows.q: 海外供应商的订单数是多少
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "订单数" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" JOIN suppliers s ON p."供应商ID" = s."供应商ID" WHERE s."所在地区" = '海外'

rows.q: 各城市的黄金客户贡献了多少销售额
rows.sql: SELECT c."城市", ROUND(SUM(o."金额"), 2) AS "销售额" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."客户ID" = c."客户ID" WHERE c."等级" = '黄金' GROUP BY c."城市" ORDER BY "销售额" DESC LIMIT 100

rows.q: 华东供应商卖到上海客户的金额是多少
rows.sql: SELECT SUM(o."金额") AS "总金额" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."客户ID" = c."客户ID" JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" JOIN suppliers s ON p."供应商ID" = s."供应商ID" WHERE s."所在地区" = '华东' AND c."城市" = '上海'

rows.q: 华南地区供应商在音频设备上的销售额是多少
rows.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o."金额"), 2) AS "销售额" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" JOIN suppliers s ON p."供应商ID" = s."供应商ID" WHERE s."所在地区" = '华南' AND p."产品类别" = '音频设备'
rows.detail: 结果为 NULL，与期望 0 一致

rows.q: 金额高于平均订单金额的订单有多少笔
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "订单笔数" FROM orders WHERE "金额" > (SELECT AVG("金额") FROM orders)

rows.q: 利润最高的那笔订单来自哪个城市
rows.sql: SELECT o."订单ID", o."利润", c."城市" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."客户ID" = c."客户ID" ORDER BY o."利润" DESC LIMIT 1

rows.q: 消费金额最高的客户来自哪个城市
rows.sql: SELECT c."客户名称", c."城市", SUM(o."金额") AS "总消费金额" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."客户ID" = c."客户ID" GROUP BY c."客户ID", c."客户名称", c."城市" ORDER BY "总消费金额" DESC LIMIT 1

rows.q: 订单金额高于该客户平均订单金额的订单数是多少
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "订单数" FROM orders o WHERE o."金额" > (SELECT AVG(o2."金额") FROM orders o2 WHERE o2."客户ID" = o."客户ID")

rows.q: 买过音频设备的客户数是多少
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o."客户ID") AS "客户数" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" WHERE p."产品类别" = '音频设备'

rows.q: 从未下过订单的客户数是多少
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "未下单客户数" FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o."客户ID" = c."客户ID")

rows.q: 没有卖出去过的产品数是多少
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "未售出产品数" FROM products WHERE "产品ID" NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT "产品ID" FROM orders WHERE "产品ID" IS NOT NULL)

rows.q: 买过充电宝的客户有多少
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o."客户ID") AS "购买充电宝客户数" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" WHERE p."产品名称" = '充电宝'

rows.q: 供货的产品全部卖出去过的供应商有几家
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "供应商家数" FROM (SELECT s."供应商ID" FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON p."供应商ID" = s."供应商ID" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p2 WHERE p2."供应商ID" = s."供应商ID" AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o."产品ID" = p2."产品ID")) GROUP BY s."供应商ID") t

rows.q: 订单数超过100笔的客户有多少
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "客户数" FROM (SELECT "客户ID", COUNT(*) AS "订单数" FROM orders GROUP BY "客户ID" HAVING COUNT(*) > 100) t

rows.q: 消费金额超过5万元的客户有多少
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "客户数" FROM (SELECT o."客户ID", SUM(o."金额") AS "消费总额" FROM orders o GROUP BY o."客户ID" HAVING SUM(o."金额") > 50000) t

rows.q: 订单数超过2000笔的产品有多少
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "产品数量" FROM (SELECT p."产品名称", COUNT(*) AS "订单数" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" GROUP BY p."产品名称" HAVING COUNT(*) > 2000) t

rows.q: 销售额超过10万元的类别有多少
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "类别数" FROM (SELECT p."产品类别", SUM(o."金额") AS "类别销售额" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" GROUP BY p."产品类别" HAVING SUM(o."金额") > 100000) t

rows.q: 2026年3月音频设备的销售额是多少
rows.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o."金额"), 2) AS "销售额" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" WHERE p."产品类别" = '音频设备' AND o."订单日期" >= '2026-03-01' AND o."订单日期" <= '2026-03-31'

rows.q: 2026年下半年华东供应商的订单数是多少
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o."订单ID") AS "订单数" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" JOIN suppliers s ON p."供应商ID" = s."供应商ID" WHERE s."所在地区" = '华东' AND o."订单日期" >= '2026-07-01' AND o."订单日期" <= '2026-12-31'

rows.q: 2026年11月黄金客户的消费金额是多少
rows.sql: SELECT SUM(o."金额") AS "消费金额" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."客户ID" = c."客户ID" WHERE c."等级" = '黄金' AND o."订单日期" >= '2026-11-01' AND o."订单日期" <= '2026-11-30'

rows.q: 每个月华东供应商的销售额是多少
rows.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o."订单日期") AS "月份", ROUND(SUM(o."金额"), 2) AS "销售额" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" JOIN suppliers s ON p."供应商ID" = s."供应商ID" WHERE s."所在地区" = '华东' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o."订单日期") ORDER BY "月份" ASC LIMIT 100

rows.q: 整体利润率是多少
rows.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM("利润") * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM("金额"), 0), 2) AS "整体利润率(%)" FROM orders

rows.q: 华东供应商的利润率是多少
rows.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o."利润") * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o."金额"), 0), 2) AS "利润率(%)" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID" JOIN suppliers s ON p."供应商ID" = s."供应商ID" WHERE s."所在地区" = '华东'

rows.q: 音频设备占整体销售额的比例是多少
rows.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p."产品类别" = '音频设备' THEN o."金额" ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o."金额"), 0), 2) AS "音频设备销售额占比(%)" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o."产品ID" = p."产品ID"

rows.q: 黄金客户的消费金额占比是多少
rows.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c."等级" = '黄金' THEN o."金额" ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o."金额"), 0), 2) AS "黄金客户消费金额占比(%)" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."客户ID" = c."客户ID"

rows.q: 销售额前三的供应商
